name: SP1 critic ID sanitization before revision

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-01 critic system prompt instructs not to suggest specific IDs

steps.text: the template critic_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "Do NOT suggest specific IDs in remedies"
the template text contains "Describe WHAT should be added"
the template text contains "not what ID it should have"
the template text contains "Let the revision model assign IDs"

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-02 critic system prompt provides examples of what to avoid

steps.text: the template critic_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "a responsibility for input validation"
the template text contains "not 'add RESP-5'"
the template text contains "not 'add PM-0-1'"

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-03 non-conforming IDs are stripped from suggested_remedy

steps.text: a CriticFindings with a gap whose suggested_remedy contains "<bad_id>"
sanitize_critic_ids is called on the findings
the suggested_remedy does not contain "<bad_id>"
the suggested_remedy contains a generic description

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-04 conforming IDs are preserved in suggested_remedy

steps.text: a CriticFindings with a gap whose suggested_remedy references existing element "<good_id>"
sanitize_critic_ids is called on the findings
the suggested_remedy still contains "<good_id>"

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-05 suggested_remedy without any IDs is unchanged

steps.text: a CriticFindings with a gap whose suggested_remedy is "Add a responsibility for input validation"
sanitize_critic_ids is called on the findings
the suggested_remedy is unchanged

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-06 multiple gaps with non-conforming IDs are all sanitized

steps.text: a CriticFindings with three gaps each containing a different non-conforming ID
sanitize_critic_ids is called on the findings
none of the suggested_remedy strings contain non-conforming IDs
the findings still have three gaps

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-07 sanitize_critic_ids preserves checklist and taxonomy results

steps.text: a CriticFindings with gaps, checklist_results, and taxonomy_probe_results
sanitize_critic_ids is called on the findings
the result is a CriticFindings model
the checklist_results are preserved
the taxonomy_probe_results are preserved

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-08 sanitized findings flow to revision without non-conforming IDs

steps.text: a CriticFindings with a non-conforming ID in a suggested_remedy
the findings are sanitized and passed to the revision prompt
the revision user prompt does not contain the non-conforming ID

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-SAN-09 sanitization is called after critic and before revision

steps.text: a control structure and CriticFindings with unjustified gaps containing a non-conforming ID
the Stage 2 revision block runs
sanitize_critic_ids is called after run_completeness_critic returns
sanitize_critic_ids is called before run_revision is called

background.text: the STPA system model critic module is importable
the STPA system model prompts directory is available
the TemplateLoader can load templates from the prompts directory
